name: library-update
title: Library update check
description: Use this skill to check whether @lewishowles/components or @lewishowles/helpers has new releases since the installed version, review the release notes, and identify what to update in the current project.
when: When checking for updates to @lewishowles/components or @lewishowles/helpers after a new release
do-not-use-when: Updating unrelated packages or general project dependencies
Preparing or publishing a new library release
Using the installed helper or component APIs without checking for newer releases
